test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Simplify (36a² - 49b²)/(6a + 7b).
solution:
**Formula used:**

(a² - b²) = (a + b) × (a - b)

**Calculation:**

(36a² - 49b²)/(6a + 7b)

⇒ {(6a)² - (7b)²}/(6a + 7b)

⇒ {(6a + 7b) × (6a - 7b)}/(6a + 7b)

⇒ (6a - 7b)

**∴ The correct answer is (6a - 7b).**
